「各位如此匆忙，是要找早柚？原来如此，那位又失踪了吗…下午她一般会躲在树上。如果找不到，可以再联络我，我自有办法。不过…呵呵，我要是出手，这件差事就不能算是诸位自主完成的了。对吧。」——神里绫人

隶属于「终末番」的忍者。个子小小的，行动非常敏捷。

说到身高啊…早柚停止长高已经很久了，久到她觉得自己落入了一个时间停止的梦。

「什么时候才能长个子呢？是我睡得还不够吗？」

偶尔醒来的小忍者这样想着，又一头扎进梦乡里。

早柚坚持认为睡眠可以补充能量，能量够了就能长高。为完成这一执念，她想尽办法偷懒，把忍术修炼得炉火纯青。

逃跑、匿踪、变幻…无论哪一方面，早柚都堪称大师。一片树叶，一个水桶，有时可以有别的名字，例如：早柚。

因此，若是「终末番」有需要早柚出马的工作，总要大费周章先找到她。

当然从早柚自己的角度看，这不叫偷懒，只是把时间花在了睡觉长高之类更有意义的事情上。

大部分稻妻人并不知道「终末番」的存在。事实上，「终末番」是「社奉行」麾下的一个秘密组织。

而「终末番」里还有一位名叫早柚的小小忍者，这件事情，更是鲜为人知。

早柚是「终末番」里的一个特殊的存在。

自幼在「终末番」里长大的她，对组织有着极高的忠诚度。

然而，她身上最强的特质却不是「忠诚」，而是「偷懒」。

「偷懒」是早柚最擅长的事。她早已熟练掌握逃跑、气息隐蔽等各种可以用来偷懒、怠工的忍术。

不了解她习性的人，想要找到她，可得费上一番功夫。

但有关偷懒一事，早柚本人的说辞如下：

绝不是懒，只是想把时间用在更有意义的事情上。

:"起风的时候…","content":"风起之时，便是开溜的好时机。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/d85827134716736de5c84bc0c0c0e79e_2735019313478750755.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"09起风的时候…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"风吹得眼睛睁不开了，不如就这样，闭起眼睛睡一觉吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/ccec9b6159c5cc4da614a92161e289f2_2497216396258176714.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"10刮大风了…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"早上好…","content":"已经…已经早上了吗？再睡10分钟…就10分钟嘛…那、那5分钟也行…呼…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/996b716ed736c68728c9af5ffe3ee8f6_3852851629893972373.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"11早上好…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"中午好…","content":"好困，午睡时间还没到吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/91d0d2d105fccb9330c78eb19b5b3d21_4585467935609018123.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"12中午好…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"确认完毕，方圆十里内没有巫女姐姐的踪影。今晚可以睡个好觉啦~","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/921c68a6ed03aed886ec086822501d77_7006429738981509471.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"13晚上好…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"晚安…","content":"终于…可以睡觉了…晚…晚安…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/4180cac6dc24381ab7c98873ba1064e0_2786158951343861328.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"14晚安…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于早柚自己·终末番","content":"我虽然属于「终末番」，但交给我的工作无非就是些情报收集、偷取物品之类的琐事。所以…所以不做也没有什么关系嘛。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/d2874fda3dfc1a16454762c220d0d53b_1356786196321848256.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"15关于早柚自己·终末番_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于早柚自己·旷工","content":"「终末番」的工作本来就没什么意义嘛，一直拖着不做，就会有更合适的人去做。但是睡觉不一样啊，只要睡得够久，说不定哪天就能长高了，这可是意义非凡的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/c45fd0271dc6e14afb69163e63e21d6b_3706980116004839000.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"16关于早柚自己·旷工_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·帮个忙","content":"如果巫女姐姐来了，记得告诉我一声哦，我稍微睡…啊不，休息会儿。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/32165f23a063ef59471255461a5dec57_6543362235488998253.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"17关于我们·帮个忙_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·摸摸头","content":"摸摸头？唔，如果是你的话…那好吧，我不会咬你的，但是不能摸太久了，否则会长不高的！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/c5bdbfef9e663b7c76947316da04a8cc_5600637594339516167.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"18关于我们·摸摸头_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"双手剑真的很重，光靠忍术的话，我肯定举不起来。但是有了「神之眼」就不一样了，所以不管怎么说，「神之眼」对我帮助很大。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/76efa792cd32ac3c7f3fcef740fb2233_2203912273426607403.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"19关于「神之眼」…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"老师说我是我们流派最后一代传人了。毕竟也不是什么特别适合战斗的流派，我学的也都是些逃跑和隐蔽气息用的忍术，这也是没办法的事情吧…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/4415bade3a82c319733f9c5d69a94f24_6459897315685663463.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"20有什么想要分享…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"你知道貉吗？一种比狸猫可爱得多的小动物，下次带你一起去看看吧~","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/00a12727d3018926ea738301adcc50e5_2342579224109794921.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"21感兴趣的见闻…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于神里绫华…","content":"神里家的大小姐优雅又端庄，但是她专门任命了一位巫女姐姐来监督我，不让我偷懒…怎会如此…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/7d45f11eb6f2dd85ca48b9d090f497c9_4167199488329111895.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"22关于神里绫华…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于神里绫人…","content":"我在树上休息的时候，经常会听到巫女姐姐们在聊他，似乎是一位工作很忙的大人。真是奇怪，工作什么的明明旷掉就好了…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/0f39e8add26a861ee645b5119e22d0a4_8577914610761517235.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"23关于神里绫人…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于托马…","content":"明明都有神之眼了，他每次出现还是缠着我说想要学忍术，真是搞不懂。而且我睡觉的时间都不够，哪有时间教他嘛。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/1ada0fd80a2440eb5c8ca824d58f1b91_5189406573809795138.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"24关于托马…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于宵宫…","content":"她每次碰到我就说什么，小狸猫我们一起去祭典玩之类的话。我才不是狸猫，也不想去祭典。说是一起去玩，其实就是想着在祭典上让我配合她的烟火表演忍术，但是这和「终末番」的工作有什么关联嘛！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/8eb8b06806b9ce400e7b3cd79a3dc8fb_8396062466608310772.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"25关于宵宫…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于雷电将军…","content":"那位大人…不是我能见到的人物。想知道更多事情的话，或许问问绫华大小姐比较好。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/3e1cfe989e81695eb2b60f8827b2e832_2409523822667099344.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"26关于雷电将军…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于八重神子…","content":"她总喜欢摸我的头，可是我不敢咬她，也不敢反抗，总感觉如果拒绝了她会发生很可怕的事情。但是，再这样被摸下去，我会不会真的长不高了？怎么办呀…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/26e5dc014f5d261af3a52fa7b2236b14_2520762960293970512.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"27关于八重神子…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于荒泷一斗…","content":"怎么会有这么吵吵嚷嚷的人，而且他还能长这么高！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/b3bbaf2795e0460ef4a3f49c3d700ad8_9146799935972030172.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"28关于荒泷一斗…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于久岐忍…","content":"没什么印象的名字，让我想想…欸？她是荒泷一斗的小弟吗？那肯定也是干扰睡眠的人，毕竟有个词叫做一丘之貉，啊不对，是一丘之狸！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/3e48b95dd20c575f0fab820670b6c553_6856972864491311541.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"29关于久岐忍…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于绮良良…","content":"有次我午觉睡醒，感觉身后暖和和的，一转头就看见有只猫正蜷着睡觉，关键是有一对毛茸茸的尾巴！吓得我差点从树枝上掉下去。这，这也是变身术吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/3488ed2d5675b7ae7b65dde7330939b7_356706626615923296.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"30关于绮良良…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"关于梦见月瑞希…","content":"奇怪的紫色妖怪…被她盯着的时候，感觉好像要被吃掉一样…唔！惹不起，我还是躲着她走吧！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2025/05/12/50494840/74cb9c64b7be3c1fbcddb858014b473f_8601713556402705808.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"汉语.mp3"},{"name":"关于布伦妮…","content":"她送了我一本很厚的书，叫《营养学导论》，她说光睡觉是不够的，还要按照上面的公式吃饭才能长高。但是，她明明懂这么多，我们好像也差不多高嘛…奇怪，难道她不想长高吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/05/29/50494840/7ba35493a6c97f97984e3487cae84e4c_7396693282535868694.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"早柚关于布伦妮…ch.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其一","content":"呼——","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/4f7ae5a4290e60c29dd71430188fd707_1131230609919875857.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"31想要了解早柚·其一_cn.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其二","content":"呃…你是问我忍术流派的名字吗？那个…想不起来了啦，我还没睡醒，我再去睡一觉，睡醒后说不定就能想起来了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/24cf906ba796c11f5b0f8f977812c819_307057519196889080.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"32想要了解早柚·其二_cn.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其三","content":"好吧，告诉你也行。你先答应我不准笑，不然我就再也不理你了。我们流派叫做——呜呼流…说是因为我们流派的忍术以戏弄敌人为长而取的名字，可是，可是…唉。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/bb7bb20aeb22043c574e1c87533c3b7e_4081358327513295067.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"33想要了解早柚·其三_cn.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其四","content":"你会爬树吗？我非常擅长这个，可以教你哦。还有，神社那边有棵树特别适合偷…啊不，特别适合小憩。下次你想睡午觉的时候，记得来找我，我们一起爬上去午睡吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/0887092217cbc638dac7baf0ebedd403_4817987619322511910.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"34想要了解早柚·其四_cn.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其五","content":"其实这套衣服是老师给我的，说是以貉为原型做的，还有助于我逃跑什么的…然后又说我已经长大了可以独当一面了，但也要保护好自己，说完老师就离开了我。可我这个身高，真的能独当一面吗…唔…欸？你是说你会陪着我吗？你真的不会离开我吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/8c105e2a4b91efe98cc0ad12b5d4e39e_6793818638374668653.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"35想要了解早柚·其五_cn.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的爱好…","content":"套上衣服上的帽子，不用担心会被巫女姐姐找到，然后睡个天昏地暗，这应该是世界上最幸福的事情了吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/1ca741b770b054af62ebe7566a915d4c_5898750829474441222.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"36早柚的爱好…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的烦恼·误会","content":"很多人第一次见到我的时候，都会大呼小叫，还把我当成狸猫。可早柚就是早柚，才不是狸猫。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/222ccffb99ad7f878044fe3f3b64543e_5250908443837557954.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"37早柚的烦恼·误会_cn.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的烦恼·身高","content":"什么时候才能长高呢？跟我同年的人身高都快是我的两倍了，可我还…不行，再睡久一点一定能长高的！我要睡觉了，晚安。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/4046d8d8bb22df0c74b7695f4c0ab5bb_7007345827597012384.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"38早柚的烦恼·身高_cn.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的烦恼·死循环","content":"我上次听人说，烦恼太多也会长不高…呜，我该怎么办才好…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/f4446609854180ad4fa4f540f18be5ee_1418004751151560508.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"39早柚的烦恼·死循环_cn.mp3"},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"能一下子提供很多能量的食物吧，比如说饭团。睡醒了吃一个就不会头晕眼花，然后又能继续睡觉了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/5928436d00c48197e06cde7570520977_2198045413817535207.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"40喜欢的食物…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"想要长高的话，就不能挑食！说来最近好像身高也没有变化，是不是因为蔬菜吃少了，但是沙拉真的没有办法提供饱腹感，而且还苦苦的，呜欸——","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/cebbfb6116dff704b4cce6a5a558b6ef_7071655108097245386.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"41讨厌的食物…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"肚子好饱。这下可以安心睡觉啦。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/9ae392eb404f8295056cb37bbae2f675_1957504117866748931.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"42收到赠礼·其一_cn.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"吃着吃着…就困了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/abbdd1cebf481a77aabd45c0a97cf695_4841644946930418386.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"43收到赠礼·其二_cn.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"要想个办法…逃走。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/02281df79d8d5bf62240c9a876c249da_6622602930505496707.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"44收到赠礼·其三_cn.mp3"},{"name":"生日…","content":"你有什么想学的忍术吗？我可以教你！当然仅限于我会的。呃？你问我为什么不睡觉？嗯…我还不困，而且，而且今天是特别的日子，我不可以睡过去，因为我想亲口对你说——生日快乐呀。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/64025888779d26bb833f532a6781eda7_3593910213386531584.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"45生日…_cn.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"我有长高一点点吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/7cc8b0ac0f51cb7131cff045c60b1630_8194933231501091545.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"46突破的感受·起_cn.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"太好了，能溜得更快了，这下子肯定不会被抓住了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/809c2dd03dee9704ff6deae269b409d0_5440279708731505318.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"47突破的感受·承_cn.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"谢谢你帮我收集了那么多材料，要是我自己来的话…肯定在路上就会睡着了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/8d2db4ca4c86753e3cba141ca03cde30_1311435300164904188.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"48突破的感受·转_cn.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"我好像确实像老师说的那样，可以独当一面了。这样子长不长高或许对我来说也没有那么重要了，因为现在重要的是…有你陪在我身边。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/08d3e4cf54e1c66bcb1edb7cbe1a72e8_7384382357748628697.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"49突破的感受·合_cn.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"走啦…唔。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/d77ba2c6a6a6b8f9409e1aeeeb1ac586_3265815813993194063.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"50元素战技·其一_cn.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"溜咯…啊。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/3f6cca0fb887419b12445a8fe312d2fa_2467530950022166657.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"51元素战技·其二_cn.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"咕噜，哈！…嘿呀。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/80fe1daa1602eade5c308c06c7f99ad5_5942479178904163920.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"52元素战技·其三_cn.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"极意遁走。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/abb627474062af128a3b6047316e989b_6641494373500767598.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"53元素战技·其四_cn.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"抓不住我…呜。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/177461cae55d1b8cb37732867cf3d64d_4037419995515618555.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"54元素战技·其五_cn.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其六","content":"随风而遁…呜。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/7f8c3f7cb19ef0b41bccc18f1f6e6a27_4361447989931321102.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"55元素战技·其六_cn.mp3"},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"分身之术。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/12a341d8ccfb0b68f8dab09c00fb72f0_2025357436212097010.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"56元素爆发·其一_cn.mp3"},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"出来吧！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/c23eabb58e48cca0e11433f430198a44_2553436698987691697.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"57元素爆发·其二_cn.mp3"},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"嘿咻…呜。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/edf8ae3d0ccf573300ebc6f3907ec26b_18103243542812444.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"58元素爆发·其三_cn.mp3"},{"name":"冲刺开始·其一","content":"疾风遁术。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/1025f0461e96f767c5dfa4fd9251792f_3826095097993036940.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"59冲刺开始·其一_cn.mp3"},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"这个箱子…好像可以睡进去。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/31d094956ee58bb7800b323ff4a80ff7_7464916275112287125.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"60打开宝箱·其一_cn.mp3"},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"大丰收！可以睡觉了吗 50b7c715fae2c6dc76d_4184631835280524841.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"10刮大风了…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"早上好…","content":"已经…已经早上了吗？再睡10分钟…就10分钟嘛…那、那5分钟也行…呼…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/0f782d55998cadc0d879e69fff0916a4_6972967088620421853.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"11早上好…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"中午好…","content":"好困，午睡时间还没到吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/47030adea5b2f53ac186f3771ddf4d6f_4444406829423473227.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"12中午好…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"确认完毕，方圆十里内没有巫女姐姐的踪影。今晚可以睡个好觉啦~","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/e4adfb9bec3a5bde103e93994ec6dc26_6248319131193205168.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"13晚上好…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"晚安…","content":"终于…可以睡觉了…晚…晚安…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/1da050e8f5b9d27c7713f9e484fc359d_2769837358868548379.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"14晚安…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于早柚自己·终末番","content":"我虽然属于「终末番」，但交给我的工作无非就是些情报收集、偷取物品之类的琐事。所以…所以不做也没有什么关系嘛。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/c610e4e5588da780c5e8815f194ad3c7_2754197074226668161.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"15关于早柚自己·终末番_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于早柚自己·旷工","content":"「终末番」的工作本来就没什么意义嘛，一直拖着不做，就会有更合适的人去做。但是睡觉不一样啊，只要睡得够久，说不定哪天就能长高了，这可是意义非凡的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/ad94ea7c2f756065b4aa56dd63d27bac_8219185376517085291.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"16关于早柚自己·旷工_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·帮个忙","content":"如果巫女姐姐来了，记得告诉我一声哦，我稍微睡…啊不，休息会儿。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/af4b1dd07c1a2af86414686c8b934f48_2271465683165367946.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"17关于我们·帮个忙_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·摸摸头","content":"摸摸头？唔，如果是你的话...那好吧，我不会咬你的，但是不能摸太久了，否则会长不高的！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/2519f70c210304510474b8ea6541aa4a_7463110816110094291.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"18关于我们·摸摸头_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"双手剑真的很重，光靠忍术的话，我肯定举不起来。但是有了「神之眼」就不一样了，所以不管怎么说，「神之眼」对我帮助很大。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/3e898adf3b3697c70b7dcbac06be5797_1043227487950353660.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"19关于「神之眼」…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"老师说我是我们流派最后一代传人了。毕竟也不是什么特别适合战斗的流派，我学的也都是些逃跑和隐蔽气息用的忍术，这也是没办法的事情吧…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/afcd2914d50b2397a7efaf36cb5d2bed_700499075985702221.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"20有什么想要分享…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"你知道貉吗？一种比狸猫可爱得多的小动物，下次带你一起去看看吧~","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/bd4ede1017aa2f2c58d25b9ec3b3fb18_2967836710681357689.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"21感兴趣的见闻…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于神里绫华…","content":"神里家的大小姐优雅又端庄，但是她专门任命了一位巫女姐姐来监督我，不让我偷懒…怎会如此…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/c292c0e4e2c360ae05f024523fc4bcb4_867793715791416455.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"22关于神里绫华…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于神里绫人…","content":"我在树上休息的时候，经常会听到巫女姐姐们在聊他，似乎是一位工作很忙的大人。真是奇怪，工作什么的明明旷掉就好了…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/31709439a400992ebe1dc9c7fb55b753_3798752870544242742.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"23关于神里绫人…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于托马…","content":"明明都有神之眼了，他每次出现还是缠着我说想要学忍术，真是搞不懂。而且我睡觉的时间都不够，哪有时间教他嘛。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/2d2da181324326b27585697b3bdbe0e1_2221865856447508499.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"24关于托马…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于宵宫…","content":"她每次碰到我就说什么，小狸猫我们一起去祭典玩之类的话。我才不是狸猫，也不想去祭典。说是一起去玩，其实就是想着在祭典上让我配合她的烟火表演忍术，但是这和「终末番」的工作有什么关联嘛！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/9280d1a8b92e2bb554ec1ce97fd106ca_1800786936115392704.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"25关于宵宫…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于雷电将军…","content":"那位大人…不是我能见到的人物。想知道更多事情的话，或许问问绫华大小姐比较好。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/50dae7c9ad3b97f12d0af8c5fe01c61f_8296628890127136014.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"26关于雷电将军…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于八重神子…","content":"她总喜欢摸我的头，可是我不敢咬她，也不敢反抗，总感觉如果拒绝了她会发生很可怕的事情。但是，再这样被摸下去，我会不会真的长不高了？怎么办呀…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/f4f556785b9af852b01a70d982130c48_6402276949385369514.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"27关于八重神子…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于荒泷一斗…","content":"怎么会有这么吵吵嚷嚷的人，而且他还能长这么高！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/de65c7d9932efd26a3373388f5f3c222_2117617563060365771.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"28关于荒泷一斗…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于久岐忍…","content":"没什么印象的名字，让我想想…欸？她是荒泷一斗的小弟吗？那肯定也是干扰睡眠的人，毕竟有个词叫做一丘之貉，啊不对，是一丘之狸！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/b191490701a76f6d85961c4ac0b22a85_1169784476412446383.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"29关于久岐忍…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于绮良良…","content":"有次我午觉睡醒，感觉身后暖和和的，一转头就看见有只猫正蜷着睡觉，关键是有一对毛茸茸的尾巴！吓得我差点从树枝上掉下去。这，这也是变身术吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/14e540beda74e4775dab04035aed1935_4852779197557822637.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"30关于绮良良…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"关于梦见月瑞希…","content":"奇怪的紫色妖怪…被她盯着的时候，感觉好像要被吃掉一样…唔！惹不起，我还是躲着她走吧！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2025/05/12/50494840/d3efe0014c881bddefc10811d53fa839_3382563319100445398.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"日语.mp3"},{"name":"关于布伦妮…","content":"她送了我一本很厚的书，叫《营养学导论》，她说光睡觉是不够的，还要按照上面的公式吃饭才能长高。但是，她明明懂这么多，我们好像也差不多高嘛…奇怪，难道她不想长高吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/05/29/50494840/7d17356d0aa592d2e99a4e18ff29c7c5_8891801533399642555.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"早柚关于布伦妮…jp.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其一","content":"呼——","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/d236b833f1ee52403dea39f5d59ef242_1123755444379847271.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"31想要了解早柚·其一_jp.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其二","content":"呃…你是问我忍术流派的名字吗？那个…想不起来了啦，我还没睡醒，我再去睡一觉，睡醒后说不定就能想起来了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/2241fa7a96f84ba98cb994039ab3a53a_7273106791200145011.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"32想要了解早柚·其二_jp.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其三","content":"好吧，告诉你也行。你先答应我不准笑，不然我就再也不理你了。我们流派叫做——呜呼流…说是因为我们流派的忍术以戏弄敌人为长而取的名字，可是，可是…唉。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/715254d4c1b864200aed3468e6aa4b69_8953141517854057772.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"33想要了解早柚·其三_jp.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其四","content":"你会爬树吗？我非常擅长这个，可以教你哦。还有，神社那边有棵树特别适合偷…啊不，特别适合小憩。下次你想睡午觉的时候，记得来找我，我们一起爬上去午睡吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/a4d04db4ac5b671e41c863713132464b_4553936915179939666.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"34想要了解早柚·其四_jp.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其五","content":"其实这套衣服是老师给我的，说是以貉为原型做的，还有助于我逃跑什么的…然后又说我已经长大了可以独当一面了，但也要保护好自己，说完老师就离开了我。可我这个身高，真的能独当一面吗…唔…欸？你是说你会陪着我吗？你真的不会离开我吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/febb2e87e97bf8526749fd0651194415_5220075124193283929.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"35想要了解早柚·其五_jp.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的爱好…","content":"套上衣服上的帽子，不用担心会被巫女姐姐找到，然后睡个天昏地暗，这应该是世界上最幸福的事情了吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/e71ebb91dd9e9efebaae443f337cf629_8094932315237177785.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"36早柚的爱好…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的烦恼·误会","content":"很多人第一次见到我的时候，都会大呼小叫，还把我当成狸猫。可早柚就是早柚，才不是狸猫。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/19ff3f634cea5df61ecbb4938c5b949c_133156662919230022.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"37早柚的烦恼·误会_jp.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的烦恼·身高","content":"什么时候才能长高呢？跟我同年的人身高都快是我的两倍了，可我还…不行，再睡久一点一定能长高的！我要睡觉了，晚安。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/fc467683e6180268c9240e1f839ca2e7_3906124648229642394.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"38早柚的烦恼·身高_jp.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的烦恼·死循环","content":"我上次听人说，烦恼太多也会长不高…呜，我该怎么办才好…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/c890d5f51e11da01faa2d885cfd990fc_3987626173609914110.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"39早柚的烦恼·死循环_jp.mp3"},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"能一下子提供很多能量的食物吧，比如说饭团。睡醒了吃一个就不会头晕眼花，然后又能继续睡觉了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/e4c12253507f5f8a883d238eac2ff29a_6866267526399939302.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"40喜欢的食物…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"想要长高的话，就不能挑食！说来最近好像身高也没有变化，是不是因为蔬菜吃少了，但是沙拉真的没有办法提供饱腹感，而且还苦苦的，呜欸——","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/4b10abca8a2cb511b44cdead6fae7891_653878657002475335.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"41讨厌的食物…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"肚子好饱。这下可以安心睡觉啦。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/f5acabe83e630dcf4b23f7433c3bf6d7_4659277290205702893.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"42收到赠礼·其一_jp.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"吃着吃着…就困了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/98ce08d47df192829d746c234658c100_3955791609495519632.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"43收到赠礼·其二_jp.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"要想个办法…逃走。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/95008db77ac66f2322f9f9c99c4e8e0a_2374281077649519773.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"44收到赠礼·其三_jp.mp3"},{"name":"生日…","content":"你有什么想学的忍术吗？我可以教你！当然仅限于我会的。呃？你问我为什么不睡觉？嗯…我还不困，而且，而且今天是特别的日子，我不可以睡过去，因为我想亲口对你说——生日快乐呀。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/df5e3a10022ff9fd213610f37ab4a0d6_2998427962648746422.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"45生日…_jp.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"我有长高一点点吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/798a087736757b5fe1623c3eb25a1795_7082992667351326507.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"46突破的感受·起_jp.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"太好了，能溜得更快了，这下子肯定不会被抓住了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/faae60b6d572f0536aacb017fc132d87_7145944801905542438.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"47突破的感受·承_jp.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"谢谢你帮我收集了那么多材料，要是我自己来的话…肯定在路上就会睡着了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/e3a611ad8ed417ee27a540e770109f11_8036840255868914302.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"48突破的感受·转_jp.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"我好像确实像老师说的那样，可以独当一面了。这样子长不长高或许对我来说也没有那么重要了，因为现在重要的是…有你陪在我身边。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/04c8a8faa426433f3a4af3754e941ee3_2328023052068000792.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"49突破的感受·合_jp.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"走啦…唔。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/13d39fccd4aed3a5dd5143db09b29e08_7943584541469037738.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"50元素战技·其一_jp.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"溜咯…啊。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/63b1374a8dc3e0359bd12f54c24e891f_6820067472430266548.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"51元素战技·其二_jp.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"咕噜，哈！…嘿呀。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/3d991849b0ec1013510a47af6a1111c1_1890853153512366742.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"52元素战技·其三_jp.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"极意遁走。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/4f6599e0ca0ad1999cd81bc659f4662b_5487721931501945479.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"53元素战技·其四_jp.mp3"},{"name":"元素 闲聊·工作_en.mp3"},{"name":"闲聊·长高","content":"什么时候才能长高呢？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/7d31e6f78e2da8bd9015b7ef10de2519_6347149113138560662.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"04闲聊·长高_en.mp3"},{"name":"下雨的时候…","content":"快躲雨，被雨淋到就长不高了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/99d1e7923511a1ec15beebd7800d1128_4869807217469530686.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"05下雨的时候…_en.mp3"},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"好大的动静，不过只要整个人都钻到被子里就能安稳睡觉了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/6e46bad6baee4ee9d7482f9ed47e6092_1902546522335942242.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"06打雷的时候…_en.mp3"},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"雪天很方便躲藏。比如说「雪降之隐」这种忍术，借助飘雪隐去身形，等别人察觉的时候，对方的眼前就只剩下飘落的雪花了。啊，你千万不要把这些告诉巫女姐姐。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/d061206df5511c50d5c7bfe896ef8603_1510027134606008641.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"07下雪的时候…_en.mp3"},{"name":"阳光很好…","content":"舒舒服服的好天气，啊——好困哦。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/300ace652ae48c48f7a295389f457cc7_8774411818042209728.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"08阳光很好…_en.mp3"},{"name":"起风的时候…","content":"风起之时，便是开溜的好时机。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/a9fc3b8b95d47b20fcd855e56c6c0efd_461927714911491995.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"09起风的时候…_en.mp3"},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"风吹得眼睛睁不开了，不如就这样，闭起眼睛睡一觉吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/867a8bc45533cbe13a854b909f2babaf_1001671844670120492.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"10刮大风了…_en.mp3"},{"name":"早上好…","content":"已经…已经早上了吗？再睡10分钟…就10分钟嘛…那、那5分钟也行…呼…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/3ce1dfad91b90140800c8a718706f025_7334734858782182193.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"11早上好…_en.mp3"},{"name":"中午好…","content":"好困，午睡时间还没到吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/1108708f76d43a35986678c7c83f6bf7_944058166264000537.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"12中午好…_en.mp3"},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"确认完毕，方圆十里内没有巫女姐姐的踪影。今晚可以睡个好觉啦~","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/1cca4d3c84c057b8111634cbf5c0db6a_7681731532482639916.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"13晚上好…_en.mp3"},{"name":"晚安…","content":"终于…可以睡觉了…晚…晚安…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/3145b212ee60336bcfdc7699e6f6f55a_6685369641247759090.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"14晚安…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于早柚自己·终末番","content":"我虽然属于「终末番」，但交给我的工作无非就是些情报收集、偷取物品之类的琐事。所以…所以不做也没有什么关系嘛。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/593c79f4c91ea3a2cd1cdc0b17e56223_8227805956244456988.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"15关于早柚自己·终末番_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于早柚自己·旷工","content":"「终末番」的工作本来就没什么意义嘛，一直拖着不做，就会有更合适的人去做。但是睡觉不一样啊，只要睡得够久，说不定哪天就能长高了，这可是意义非凡的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/6c1ff193fd8777fcdcf0d588b5550f75_4565800522111408994.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"16关于早柚自己·旷工_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·帮个忙","content":"如果巫女姐姐来了，记得告诉我一声哦，我稍微睡…啊不，休息会儿。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/726901c00d7edfd757e27dd09af8f036_3564523992355410314.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"17关于我们·帮个忙_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·摸摸头","content":"摸摸头？唔，如果是你的话...那好吧，我不会咬你的，但是不能摸太久了，否则会长不高的！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/e73eecc29906e4c928ca941dc6ac9576_2054562508583592730.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"18关于我们·摸摸头_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"双手剑真的很重，光靠忍术的话，我肯定举不起来。但是有了「神之眼」就不一样了，所以不管怎么说，「神之眼」对我帮助很大。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/6fa30b656960dbbf2df82c2316ca0fdd_6666547867526276523.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"19关于「神之眼」…_en.mp3"},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"老师说我是我们流派最后一代传人了。毕竟也不是什么特别适合战斗的流派，我学的也都是些逃跑和隐蔽气息用的忍术，这也是没办法的事情吧…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/2a5afb99cd80dad71b031539dcc2b019_5726979171738237987.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"20有什么想要分享…_en.mp3"},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"你知道貉吗？一种比狸猫可爱得多的小动物，下次带你一起去看看吧~","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/fa0856ae86275110bfd3635d353c6fe9_2077352131657650340.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"21感兴趣的见闻…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于神里绫华…","content":"神里家的大小姐优雅又端庄，但是她专门任命了一位巫女姐姐来监督我，不让我偷懒…怎会如此…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/f8f94e2c0fcc44868f7d2a3ac93b7ba4_2654910067156434005.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"22关于神里绫华…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于神里绫人…","content":"我在树上休息的时候，经常会听到巫女姐姐们在聊他，似乎是一位工作很忙的大人。真是奇怪，工作什么的明明旷掉就好了…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/cc7083c93f4ba240ae49d4549b7bc097_6981843340308536060.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"23关于神里绫人…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于托马…","content":"明明都有神之眼了，他每次出现还是缠着我说想要学忍术，真是搞不懂。而且我睡觉的时间都不够，哪有时间教他嘛。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/6657ff8aa3aff295ee278d647709e941_3586437590217675114.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"24关于托马…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于宵宫…","content":"她每次碰到我就说什么，小狸猫我们一起去祭典玩之类的话。我才不是狸猫，也不想去祭典。说是一起去玩，其实就是想着在祭典上让我配合她的烟火表演忍术，但是这和「终末番」的工作有什么关联嘛！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/522c36939948d1f23f4d6b97878aea89_4086729234286153534.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"25关于宵宫…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于雷电将军…","content":"那位大人…不是我能见到的人物。想知道更多事情的话，或许问问绫华大小姐比较好。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/e02b141b77cd20efb8c13f6fca0c02f9_8021300253852348102.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"26关于雷电将军…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于八重神子…","content":"她总喜欢摸我的头，可是我不敢咬她，也不敢反抗，总感觉如果拒绝了她会发生很可怕的事情。但是，再这样被摸下去，我会不会真的长不高了？怎么办呀…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/e5d44aefe025099d11a25206aa737606_2962268907315114281.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"27关于八重神子…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于荒泷一斗…","content":"怎么会有这么吵吵嚷嚷的人，而且他还能长这么高！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/bd230ef2bc2d705b85b170f4308bb8ad_2361024796723841346.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"28关于荒泷一斗…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于久岐忍…","content":"没什么印象的名字，让我想想…欸？她是荒泷一斗的小弟吗？那肯定也是干扰睡眠的人，毕竟有个词叫做一丘之貉，啊不对，是一丘之狸！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/4b3d8506f0f34211ddc6f39024b10703_8804355019175112359.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"29关于久岐忍…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于绮良良…","content":"有次我午觉睡醒，感觉身后暖和和的，一转头就看见有只猫正蜷着睡觉，关键是有一对毛茸茸的尾巴！吓得我差点从树枝上掉下去。这，这也是变身术吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/36c1d15e42df6e1c386981fd3a8d4389_5291883568514698241.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"30关于绮良良…_en.mp3"},{"name":"关于梦见月瑞希…","content":"奇怪的紫色妖怪…被她盯着的时候，感觉好像要被吃掉一样…唔！惹不起，我还是躲着她走吧！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2025/05/12/50494840/4802668be04522a72bb89f6b71f10cce_7731713070718527404.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"英语.mp3"},{"name":"关于布伦妮…","content":"她送了我一本很厚的书，叫《营养学导论》，她说光睡觉是不够的，还要按照上面的公式吃饭才能长高。但是，她明明懂这么多，我们好像也差不多高嘛…奇怪，难道她不想长高吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/05/29/50494840/5d89f7c535129046b501eaf4c9d873e3_8463411236907467297.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"早柚关于布伦妮…en.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其一","content":"呼——","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/3962a604565685a0886e6979e7d90735_8552070720652699946.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"31想要了解早柚·其一_en.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其二","content":"呃…你是问我忍术流派的名字吗？那个…想不起来了啦，我还没睡醒，我再去睡一觉，睡醒后说不定就能想起来了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/4c0247cb96389fd73533e2dff831d87c_864849801610288771.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"32想要了解早柚·其二_en.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其三","content":"好吧，告诉你也行。你先答应我不准笑，不然我就再也不理你了。我们流派叫做——呜呼流…说是因为我们流派的忍术以戏弄敌人为长而取的名字，可是，可是…唉。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/804f6be6279bbf05658df4fa7752badd_1542650459625737232.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"33想要了解早柚·其三_en.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其四","content":"你会爬树吗？我非常擅长这个，可以教你哦。还有，神社那边有棵树特别适合偷…啊不，特别适合小憩。下次你想睡午觉的时候，记得来找我，我们一起爬上去午睡吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/2eea7d797ef74a2b0f5df80fe43f6ca8_7669088193083447565.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"34想要了解早柚·其四_en.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其五","content":"其实这套衣服是老师给我的，说是以貉为原型做的，还有助于我逃跑什么的…然后又说我已经长大了可以独当一面了，但也要保护好自己，说完老师就离开了我。可我这个身高，真的能独当一面吗…唔…欸？你是说你会陪着我吗？你真的不会离开我吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/824843c1d6215a8fbbe23358407b013e_6009622346802103183.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"35想要了解早柚·其五_en.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的爱好…","content":"套上衣服上的帽子，不用担心会被巫女姐姐找到，然后睡个天昏地暗，这应该是世界上最幸福的事情了吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/da1c968a2acfce6e18d760eff51486d3_591945040476962606.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"36早柚的爱好…_en.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的烦恼·误会","content":"很多人第一次见到我的时候，都会大呼小叫，还把我当成狸猫。可早柚就是早柚，才不是狸猫。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/c76f343db76de80e670c5b2372d5daf6_3922594646450739090.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"37早柚的烦恼·误会_en.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的烦恼·身高","content":"什么时候才能长高呢？跟我同年的人身高都快是我的两倍了，可我还…不行，再睡久一点一定能长高的！我要睡觉了，晚安。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/f2a51caf302fc0b9c508a5476b0f39b0_9023618996280862406.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"38早柚的烦恼·身高_en.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的烦恼·死循环","content":"我上次听人说，烦恼太多也会长不高…呜，我该怎么办才好…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/9f98e3d05b5a2bc3da9e718b7761a51f_7011037015564193052.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"39早柚的烦恼·死循环_en.mp3"},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"能一下子提供很多能量的食物吧，比如说饭团。睡醒了吃一个就不会头晕眼花，然后又能继续睡觉了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/c974aff4a12f2f8b109c8edbac2926b1_2117293960110589470.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"40喜欢的食物…_en.mp3"},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"想要长高的话，就不能挑食！说来最近好像身高也没有变化，是不是因为蔬菜吃少了，但是沙拉真的没有办法提供饱腹感，而且还苦苦的，呜欸——","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/141e1514a5eed5ca0d20a7a611269549_1062661745833768928.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"41讨厌的食物…_en.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"肚子好饱。这下可以安心睡觉啦。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/2d33c2d0bf3ebe3466f717b1588e38f5_8702335533349076198.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"42收到赠礼·其一_en.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"吃着吃着…就困了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/537150ac8c8b5206529b16fc727aa2ec_1711534305136709325.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"43收到赠礼·其二_en.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"要想个办法…逃走。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/33c24189b181d43cefb8e5f4f78de016_762300348895064231.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"44收到赠礼·其三_en.mp3"},{"name":"生日…","content":"你有什么想学的忍术吗？我可以教你！当然仅限于我会的。呃？你问我为什么不睡觉？嗯…我还不困，而且，而且今天是特别的日子，我不可以睡过去，因为我想亲口对你说——生日快乐呀。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/02cbdb8541b0f5fe9425dce23cfc5bd2_3597287116812234744.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"45生日…_en.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"我有长高一点点吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/36399e75f857266c5822f54849b9ae9b_2110044440674179497.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"46突破的感受·起_en.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"太好了，能溜得更快了，这下子肯定不会被抓住了。","audio_url":"https:// f684c3c7ed2e4c7ff87fee6bf10b387_6652061217115635374.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"05下雨的时候…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"打雷的时候…","content":"好大的动静，不过只要整个人都钻到被子里就能安稳睡觉了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/82b45597aad8f9c6ed688e731d8ac237_930835503730625905.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"06打雷的时候…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"下雪的时候…","content":"雪天很方便躲藏。比如说「雪降之隐」这种忍术，借助飘雪隐去身形，等别人察觉的时候，对方的眼前就只剩下飘落的雪花了。啊，你千万不要把这些告诉巫女姐姐。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/71ef1ae1e03881b84b4a1e1dac1e56e3_2438551539696027106.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"07下雪的时候…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"阳光很好…","content":"舒舒服服的好天气，啊——好困哦。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/bd328160e6406952a8827a88b4b871a9_2888282981326177408.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"08阳光很好…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"起风的时候…","content":"风起之时，便是开溜的好时机。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/024c8c2a61d5abb5377e1dcb311e37ae_8098301666501150813.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"09起风的时候…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"刮大风了…","content":"风吹得眼睛睁不开了，不如就这样，闭起眼睛睡一觉吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/715ca2943d8e48598b7cfd96d3e9163b_2358829391084040976.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"10刮大风了…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"早上好…","content":"已经…已经早上了吗？再睡10分钟…就10分钟嘛…那、那5分钟也行…呼…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/0771ce62d55b1ee41402616c73dc2de3_1398950801573722647.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"11早上好…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"中午好…","content":"好困，午睡时间还没到吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/86123948bdc3d0778a68a9b2f3685fb5_5720413318063422049.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"12中午好…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"晚上好…","content":"确认完毕，方圆十里内没有巫女姐姐的踪影。今晚可以睡个好觉啦~","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/91fc58d08e5fd4f6c0b7ea5ea6918e2e_4560942202731377122.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"13晚上好…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"晚安…","content":"终于…可以睡觉了…晚…晚安…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/67b162754ca587f9047c723746b87443_2917494352625306873.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"14晚安…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于早柚自己·终末番","content":"我虽然属于「终末番」，但交给我的工作无非就是些情报收集、偷取物品之类的琐事。所以…所以不做也没有什么关系嘛。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/0c12010383a9a7741846e62fb59f928b_6746149994079498936.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"15关于早柚自己·终末番_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于早柚自己·旷工","content":"「终末番」的工作本来就没什么意义嘛，一直拖着不做，就会有更合适的人去做。但是睡觉不一样啊，只要睡得够久，说不定哪天就能长高了，这可是意义非凡的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/f2224a7e828926e6bc631d4111176987_5335872182872754683.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"16关于早柚自己·旷工_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·帮个忙","content":"如果巫女姐姐来了，记得告诉我一声哦，我稍微睡…啊不，休息会儿。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/b71dcde3913cc7eca2f513b9953ec68b_8965641064995918153.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"17关于我们·帮个忙_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于我们·摸摸头","content":"摸摸头？唔，如果是你的话...那好吧，我不会咬你的，但是不能摸太久了，否则会长不高的！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/9e6a68af1f1a90bc89a1f4a8ff02b397_1626104975443421311.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"18关于我们·摸摸头_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于「神之眼」…","content":"双手剑真的很重，光靠忍术的话，我肯定举不起来。但是有了「神之眼」就不一样了，所以不管怎么说，「神之眼」对我帮助很大。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/6ca167b711cc941604bee1465415ecac_3180126027065763305.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"19关于「神之眼」…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"有什么想要分享…","content":"老师说我是我们流派最后一代传人了。毕竟也不是什么特别适合战斗的流派，我学的也都是些逃跑和隐蔽气息用的忍术，这也是没办法的事情吧…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/c4fa6d9a7b4fe83e473c21d90377bc82_1265391470644891149.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"20有什么想要分享…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"感兴趣的见闻…","content":"你知道貉吗？一种比狸猫可爱得多的小动物，下次带你一起去看看吧~","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/4765be3b88888b62721ff71cc3dac7ac_2187875386233323886.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"21感兴趣的见闻…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于神里绫华…","content":"神里家的大小姐优雅又端庄，但是她专门任命了一位巫女姐姐来监督我，不让我偷懒…怎会如此…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/4557c6db112c6eb3ccb649b8d670f247_1637062718485437040.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"22关于神里绫华…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于神里绫人…","content":"我在树上休息的时候，经常会听到巫女姐姐们在聊他，似乎是一位工作很忙的大人。真是奇怪，工作什么的明明旷掉就好了…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/e68c60fd2a2bba16671f6d7121f26f02_3841749989505737025.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"23关于神里绫人…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于托马…","content":"明明都有神之眼了，他每次出现还是缠着我说想要学忍术，真是搞不懂。而且我睡觉的时间都不够，哪有时间教他嘛。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/18aade110de3c24ad9a9c992f592df17_1088557048993086224.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"24关于托马…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于宵宫…","content":"她每次碰到我就说什么，小狸猫我们一起去祭典玩之类的话。我才不是狸猫，也不想去祭典。说是一起去玩，其实就是想着在祭典上让我配合她的烟火表演忍术，但是这和「终末番」的工作有什么关联嘛！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/06ee6fae0cacdab2c39d5cc8a2b1492c_392206924784593352.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"25关于宵宫…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于雷电将军…","content":"那位大人…不是我能见到的人物。想知道更多事情的话，或许问问绫华大小姐比较好。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/f4e0680538e977eb4dcee9c1b97d835c_8279234744593181546.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"26关于雷电将军…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于八重神子…","content":"她总喜欢摸我的头，可是我不敢咬她，也不敢反抗，总感觉如果拒绝了她会发生很可怕的事情。但是，再这样被摸下去，我会不会真的长不高了？怎么办呀…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/e5f498baca25fe209326fea23690365c_6288699886881754558.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"27关于八重神子…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于荒泷一斗…","content":"怎么会有这么吵吵嚷嚷的人，而且他还能长这么高！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/f35bedb120603903ee65a1e79ecee385_6603505072183875745.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"28关于荒泷一斗…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于久岐忍…","content":"没什么印象的名字，让我想想…欸？她是荒泷一斗的小弟吗？那肯定也是干扰睡眠的人，毕竟有个词叫做一丘之貉，啊不对，是一丘之狸！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/832fc4836ec2f7bcceaddc4e6acb2ced_8307076484919756247.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"29关于久岐忍…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于绮良良…","content":"有次我午觉睡醒，感觉身后暖和和的，一转头就看见有只猫正蜷着睡觉，关键是有一对毛茸茸的尾巴！吓得我差点从树枝上掉下去。这，这也是变身术吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/953a9111b8b23311256b9ba762292c61_812232673568209983.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"30关于绮良良…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"关于梦见月瑞希…","content":"奇怪的紫色妖怪…被她盯着的时候，感觉好像要被吃掉一样…唔！惹不起，我还是躲着她走吧！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2025/05/12/50494840/75d816c957384b1d1794aac8e0c29a84_2072018690248925704.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"韩语.mp3"},{"name":"关于布伦妮…","content":"她送了我一本很厚的书，叫《营养学导论》，她说光睡觉是不够的，还要按照上面的公式吃饭才能长高。但是，她明明懂这么多，我们好像也差不多高嘛…奇怪，难道她不想长高吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2026/05/29/50494840/cc0a5d3fb804d1d928598f68cdd5ba43_4020445801251774981.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"早柚关于布伦妮…kr.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其一","content":"呼——","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/9bbb107c933ce6928c5f36ede74163ad_6733655863366172750.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"31想要了解早柚·其一_kr.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其二","content":"呃…你是问我忍术流派的名字吗？那个…想不起来了啦，我还没睡醒，我再去睡一觉，睡醒后说不定就能想起来了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/d85ee366ebf9a9da56e454b4ca4eac4a_5798240847305665655.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"32想要了解早柚·其二_kr.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其三","content":"好吧，告诉你也行。你先答应我不准笑，不然我就再也不理你了。我们流派叫做——呜呼流…说是因为我们流派的忍术以戏弄敌人为长而取的名字，可是，可是…唉。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/344c6b17c3a402c4d441588e419dbfb6_5172310501310849824.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"33想要了解早柚·其三_kr.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其四","content":"你会爬树吗？我非常擅长这个，可以教你哦。还有，神社那边有棵树特别适合偷…啊不，特别适合小憩。下次你想睡午觉的时候，记得来找我，我们一起爬上去午睡吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/70c72c6c8591f1c174331a4d54281da3_5130557064114659937.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"34想要了解早柚·其四_kr.mp3"},{"name":"想要了解早柚·其五","content":"其实这套衣服是老师给我的，说是以貉为原型做的，还有助于我逃跑什么的…然后又说我已经长大了可以独当一面了，但也要保护好自己，说完老师就离开了我。可我这个身高，真的能独当一面吗…唔…欸？你是说你会陪着我吗？你真的不会离开我吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/6ab71b5f2cf10de5fbad092fbb78a74b_6003235607542124261.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"35想要了解早柚·其五_kr.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的爱好…","content":"套上衣服上的帽子，不用担心会被巫女姐姐找到，然后睡个天昏地暗，这应该是世界上最幸福的事情了吧。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/71afe2e8fc970e3e178e5c35f66e2690_7810638816043627783.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"36早柚的爱好…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的烦恼·误会","content":"很多人第一次见到我的时候，都会大呼小叫，还把我当成狸猫。可早柚就是早柚，才不是狸猫。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/f254287d8f91d87f6902b0dcc35647e6_8172516981383223082.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"37早柚的烦恼·误会_kr.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的烦恼·身高","content":"什么时候才能长高呢？跟我同年的人身高都快是我的两倍了，可我还…不行，再睡久一点一定能长高的！我要睡觉了，晚安。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/ca1713b03798d71dc8e0bcc966e1a952_6707103874591448289.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"38早柚的烦恼·身高_kr.mp3"},{"name":"早柚的烦恼·死循环","content":"我上次听人说，烦恼太多也会长不高…呜，我该怎么办才好…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/7f72c5705fade70e7a7dc3985957593b_3514998795670517035.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"39早柚的烦恼·死循环_kr.mp3"},{"name":"喜欢的食物…","content":"能一下子提供很多能量的食物吧，比如说饭团。睡醒了吃一个就不会头晕眼花，然后又能继续睡觉了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/bf8fe6a2c0b6adc5d82303bff5341c3d_8267911776028323776.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"40喜欢的食物…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"讨厌的食物…","content":"想要长高的话，就不能挑食！说来最近好像身高也没有变化，是不是因为蔬菜吃少了，但是沙拉真的没有办法提供饱腹感，而且还苦苦的，呜欸——","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/19479acfe80e53d7fb1bc756b61a16d1_2702409274718927125.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"41讨厌的食物…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其一","content":"肚子好饱。这下可以安心睡觉啦。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/dc54f7a01990b1f51ac9c9d8fcbc71c3_8460635785819132603.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"42收到赠礼·其一_kr.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其二","content":"吃着吃着…就困了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/90b3b89b1917e90b631d94cb28510614_8068198294442305918.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"43收到赠礼·其二_kr.mp3"},{"name":"收到赠礼·其三","content":"要想个办法…逃走。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/5a4e6c1dc6359e1938e74f27c97edf43_6982180178766929804.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"44收到赠礼·其三_kr.mp3"},{"name":"生日…","content":"你有什么想学的忍术吗？我可以教你！当然仅限于我会的。呃？你问我为什么不睡觉？嗯…我还不困，而且，而且今天是特别的日子，我不可以睡过去，因为我想亲口对你说——生日快乐呀。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/66b5349747aacb93a0631eac350a383c_8033535920534219208.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"45生日…_kr.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·起","content":"我有长高一点点吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/4e0dd4cf33a2cee35c543147f79118a1_4717290674805161695.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"46突破的感受·起_kr.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·承","content":"太好了，能溜得更快了，这下子肯定不会被抓住了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/0e76909833eb0071025b7225d9e8d6a0_8825527603849501063.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"47突破的感受·承_kr.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·转","content":"谢谢你帮我收集了那么多材料，要是我自己来的话…肯定在路上就会睡着了。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/cbe24a2159a1af139f05dc7b5306770b_2794713255218199565.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"48突破的感受·转_kr.mp3"},{"name":"突破的感受·合","content":"我好像确实像老师说的那样，可以独当一面了。这样子长不长高或许对我来说也没有那么重要了，因为现在重要的是…有你陪在我身边。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/3c2bb5fcfd8eabc9a2919e7dc4a66dbf_5773962907876637057.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"49突破的感受·合_kr.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其一","content":"走啦…唔。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/381c2fc3eb4ae33237178a71c38655b1_6807775751005454871.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"50元素战技·其一_kr.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其二","content":"溜咯…啊。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/f807a784ff7b9aea65f020b605a7e64e_8568255743711172985.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"51元素战技·其二_kr.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其三","content":"咕噜，哈！…嘿呀。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/fac45174436ffd2a965c89f61972a589_2894097626242917423.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"52元素战技·其三_kr.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其四","content":"极意遁走。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/b0346036be61908af3f03dfae5bbe28e_4875866867772834012.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"53元素战技·其四_kr.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其五","content":"抓不住我…呜。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/fa2323a73ee6b2caf62bdc3037c4fcbe_5278390848229708719.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"54元素战技·其五_kr.mp3"},{"name":"元素战技·其六","content":"随风而遁…呜。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/aedaa90090f0434f444b304f4df5b740_5448458705688789671.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"55元素战技·其六_kr.mp3"},{"name":"元素爆发·其一","content":"分身之术。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/d68e9d789710800fba3d5f5eb7631b0d_3962283401906303212.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"56元素爆发·其一_kr.mp3"},{"name":"元素爆发·其二","content":"出来吧！","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/193451f8a16fede35b4ed8b5b2804812_1288197391078320631.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"57元素爆发·其二_kr.mp3"},{"name":"元素爆发·其三","content":"嘿咻…呜。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/abf61708f59f41163eabb277c4849c3f_5642033721994466054.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"58元素爆发·其三_kr.mp3"},{"name":"冲刺开始·其一","content":"疾风遁术。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/6d57f213532f1757311bad901e50d61e_6875487377482471602.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"59冲刺开始·其一_kr.mp3"},{"name":"打开宝箱·其一","content":"这个箱子…好像可以睡进去。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/d9bc7b796ab0c51ef504812c0285168a_7777951933205048431.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"60打开宝箱·其一_kr.mp3"},{"name":"打开宝箱·其二","content":"大丰收！可以睡觉了吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/f46479070a5aaf00f84b8508f956d042_6030757816806069434.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"61打开宝箱·其二_kr.mp3"},{"name":"打开宝箱·其三","content":"是对长高有帮助的东西吗？","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/78346f7c70d8ff499c9941c39727aab2_6352347409834671519.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"62打开宝箱·其三_kr.mp3"},{"name":"生命值低·其一","content":"逃跑的话，该用…","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/52b3448bdd537e606beeb87f740f1bc4_5415538920039283256.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"63生命值低·其一_kr.mp3"},{"name":"生命值低·其二","content":"头晕乎乎的。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/b7abed8251db61d048a86c7eca646a8f_5209539475211542971.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"64生命值低·其二_kr.mp3"},{"name":"生命值低·其三","content":"呼，好累。","audio_url":"https://act-upload.mihoyo.com/wiki-user-upload/2024/03/04/16576950/948a7d32ce97b373849b1f7d362b0ba4_7762307821500601305.mp3","isUploading":false,"audio_name":"65生命值低·其三_kr. {"rich_text":"

早柚身材娇小，堪称玲珑。

困扰她的事，也正在于此——

同龄人一个接一个长得很高，自己却还保持着儿童模样，身高丝毫没有变化。

为此，早柚十分焦急。

日子—天天过去，世界似乎都拔高了，只有自己还是小小的。

长高这件事情，便逐渐成为了早柚心中的执念。

「只要睡得够久，就定能长高的！」

她如此坚信着，并尽可能抓住—切机会睡觉，没有机会就创造机会，没有环境就创造环境。

周围人也经常由于不忍心，而不去打扰小早柚。

于是现在甚至已经发展成，连站着的时候，早柚都能睡着。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

早柚所学的忍术虽然战斗力不高，在偷懒—事上却有相当的妙用。

她极擅长隐匿身形、消除痕迹，是这方面的专家。所以，若她有心躲藏，普通人绝对找不到。

不过，再巧妙的谜题也有答案，再隐秘的宝藏也有线索，早柚亦是如此。

相处久了，便会明白早柚的习惯和偏好。想找到她，似乎也不那么困难了。

例如，清晨去早柚的房间掀起被子，大概率能找到赖床的她。

中午时分，可以去神社附近的树上瞧瞧，说不定会有意外收获。

晚上寻找早柚的难度会增大，不过，去她屋里守株待兔着实是个好办法。

但切记，如非必要情况，请务必不要打扰正忙于长高的早柚。

兔子急了还会咬人，早柚急了…说不定也—样哦？

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

话说回来，找到早柚也并不代表能让她老老实实地投入工作。

何况早柚在「终末番」的工作并不是每日按部就班完成固定内容的形式，而是随机的。

于是，就会发生这种事情：

新任务发布时，她必不在场。

等好不容易找到她，任务现场往往也已找到更适合执行该任务的人了。

而万—除去早柚以外没有其他合适人选，她更要溜之大吉，以免被任务压垮。

只是…如此高超的忍术，若是用于勤恳工作，早柚在「终末番」里想必能有一番大作为吧。

早柚是忍术流派——「呜呼流」最后—代传人。

在这个以戏弄敌人见长的流派中，早柚学到的仅仅是逃跑、替身之类的忍术。

这些忍术在实战中用途不大，却有着不可否认的观赏性。

落叶闪过，人影瞬间消失;微风轻拂，地上突然多了一只风筝…场面之奇，堪称艺术表演。

因此每当有节日祭典，早柚就会被各方邀请前去表演她的神秘忍术。

若是宵宫找来，早柚还能想办法躲藏。

但来的若是八重宫司大人，早柚可就不敢抵抗了。

替身忍术躲不过那位大人的法眼，屏息之法更逃不出那位大人的掌心。

直接逃跑更不可取，有可能会激怒那位大人…

幸好幸好，能让宫司大人亲自出马的情况非常少。

所以可喜可贺，大部分时候，早柚还是能逃之夭夭。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

自记事起，早柚就已经在「终末番」里跟着老师学习忍术了。

「终末番」虽是个活跃于暗处的组织，长辈们却都十分和蔼，很是照顾年幼的早柚。

「过度依赖他人，对忍者来说可不是什么好事。」

早柚学习忍术陷入瓶颈后，老师观察着她的情况暗暗想道。

岁月如梭，早柚稳步成长着。等到她的能力足够自保时，老师选择了悄然离开。

离开父母庇护的幼兽会飞速成长。老师对早柚的期待亦是如此.

年轻忍者没有辜负老师的心愿。不久之后，早柚便拥有了「神之眼」。

跟着，她就在「终未番」里兢兢业业地…偷懒。

早柚忙着睡觉，忙着躲人，从这个角度来说，她也有许多事要做.

偶尔空闲下来，独自—人享受月光时，内心深处会有—些迷茫。

—直陪伴着自己的人，终有一日会离开…人生难道注定如此吗？

不过，或许在未来某天，我也会遇到—直与我相伴的人吧。

想着想着，小小的忍者便又睡去了…

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

早柚这身衣服，据说是老师送的礼物。

样式上参考了小动物的形态——「貉」，还特地选用了早柚喜欢的颜色。

穿起来轻便灵活，适合忍者。

衣服上那只巨大的帽子能带给人满满的安全感，深得早柚喜爱。

长长的尾巴造型，则是方便早柚在树枝上保持平衡。

至于唯一的缺点…大概是这身衣服看起来太像狸猫了，早柚常因此遭到误会。

最初，她还会认认真真地向对方解释:

「我不是狸猫，是早柚。」

然而时间—长，类似事件发生太多次，连狸猫都被早柚连带着憎恨上了。

如今要是再有这样的事，早柚会嘟着脸生气。

所以为了跟早柚好好相处，请熟记以下内容：

早柚不是狸猫，而是早柚。

衣服也不是狸猫，而是小貉服。

","switch":false,"is_show_switch":true,"without_border":false}

{"rich_text":"

这是早柚刚刚独自生活时的故事了。

弱小的生命们在这世上踽踽独行，免不了要提心吊胆。各种滋味，唯有经历过才能明白。

早柚正是如此。擅长观察躲避、头脑清醒的她—直明白自己不适合战斗。

过分娇小的身躯，在力量上毫无优势可言；实战中，忍术也派不上多大用处

任务不会等待忍者成长完全才降临。在这般乱世中，早柚也会因为原本不那么重要的工作而陷入危机。

强敌环伺，她必须竭尽全力才能勉强逃脱。为了安全带回情报，几乎付出一切。

精疲力尽又带着伤的她眼看就要晕厥过去，心中却只想着—件事：「并不是只有强大的蛮力才能赢得一切，弱者也有弱者的生存之道。正因为弱小，才更能留意到那些微不可查的、改变命运的瞬间…从这里逃脱的机会很渺茫，我的忍术却是为此而生。」

树叶落下的瞬间，她消失了。所有追兵都感到难以置信。小小的忍者犹如风中的尘埃一般消失不见。

翌日清晨早柚挣扎着醒来，发觉她腿上绑着的忍者包早已不翼而飞.

然而，同—位置上出现了取而代之的惊喜之物——一枚迎着朝阳闪闪发光的「神之眼」。

如今，借助「神之眼」的力量，早柚能举起比自己身高还高的双手剑，也不必为乱世中无处不在的争斗感到恐惧。

只是，她本人最切身的烦恼还未得到解决。

对于长高这件事，似乎连「神之眼」都无能为力呢。

角色

关于早柚…

布伦妮

在这个年纪，「能睡则睡」是最聪明的选择。毕竟…看看那些被工作和焦虑填满的大人吧，哪怕是一个不用依靠酒精或炼金药剂的安稳觉，都已经是奢侈品了。趁现在还能毫无负担地闭上眼，就让她睡吧。

梦见月瑞希

呵呵，除了长高的烦恼外，几乎无忧无虑的小貉…她的梦境一定很甜美。要不是她有预感般绕着我走，我还真想请她来「秋沙钱汤」工作。

旅行者·火旅行者·火


派蒙：小早柚似乎有很多烦恼呢。
派蒙：真是难以理解。
旅行者：这大概就是成长的烦恼吧。
派蒙：唔，你这句话也很难理解。
派蒙：毕竟派蒙是没什么烦恼的。
旅行者：嗯…
旅行者：糟了，背包里没几个摩拉了，接下来我们要过穷日子了…
派蒙：欸？不要啊——
旅行者：现在你有烦恼了。
派蒙：怎么会这样…

宵宫

如果你见到她，记得告诉我哦？我很想带她去参加祭典，给她介绍很多很多新朋友。因为我看她平时精神不是太好，如果认识一些能玩在一起的人，她应该就会慢慢活泼起来吧。

神里绫华

早柚这孩子，最近有没有给你添什么麻烦呢？如果看见她偷懒，可以直接告诉我。

托马

唉，早柚太倔强了。不管我找她多少次，都不肯传授我忍术。甚至最近都刻意躲着我了…明明只是想求师而已，是我做得太过头了吗？

荒泷一斗

不过是趁她不注意的时候，摸了摸她的头而已，现在一见面就要跳起来打我。哈哈哈没办法，这么可爱的小狸猫，谁见了都会忍不住想去摸摸头吧？噢对了…喊她狸猫也会被揍。为什么啊，那不就是狸猫吗…？

五郎

我军情报显示，那位忍者精通潜入之法，也许她的忍术能够在珊瑚宫大人的某些奇策中发挥作用…不过，情报里又说很难掌握她的行踪，看来不好招募啊…欸？你说她是社奉行的人？…呃，那还是算了。

八重神子

这个子小小的孩子，躲倒是挺会躲的，鹿野奈奈经常向我抱怨，得花很多时间找她，连看小说的时间都变少了。要我说啊，或许是有人在暗中帮助早柚呢？

神里绫人

她平时看起来是懒散了点，但在适当的时机，却总能给予重要帮助。你应该再清楚不过了吧？

主题：出门准备…

发件人：早柚

时间：2026-10-19

我和小魔女们约好，这次轮到我去蒙德找她们玩。听说坐船要坐很久我有点担心自己会晕，提前做了摇摇晃晃不倒貉貉练习。现在应该没问题了。

还有，虽然我在树上睡得很香，但要是在船上失眠的话可就糟糕了。好在布伦妮信里给了我一个好建议，她说，吃了饭团之后容易变困。所以我做了好多好多饭团，装进篮子里，打算睡不着就吃一个，睡不着就吃一个…干脆现在也吃一个吧。

唔…困意已经上来了…

还有最后一点行李要收…你的旅行经验比较充足，可以来帮我看看有没有漏带的东西…呼噜…

主题：美梦成真？！

发件人：早柚

时间：2025-10-19

前几天，有位脚步轻盈的妖怪小姐来神社找宫司大人，她们俩小声讲大声笑，不久后，巫女姐姐就找到我，说有个秘密任务：去「秋沙钱汤」睡觉！

「工作就是睡觉，睡觉就是工作。」这…这正是我毕生的梦想啊！

可当时我还偷听到「好梦」「美味」、「员工福利」什么的…呜！该不会是想趁我睡着的时候把我吃掉吧！

今天就是执行任务的日子了，我想过逃…但又不想放过这个可以名正言顺睡觉的好机会！

我信任你！能不能请你陪我一起去？要是我睡着的时候有什么风吹草动，拜托你把我拎起来就跑！

有你在，就能安心睡了。呼噜…

主题：问题很大…

发件人：早柚

时间：2024-10-19

大进步！秘密练习好多好多天后，我终于学会站着睡觉了！

可是，大问题也来了，我没有学会睁着眼睛睡觉，好难…

得想个办法。要是在眼皮上画上我的眼睛，那我闭上眼睛就跟没闭上眼睛一样了，你说对不对？

我买了画笔和油彩，准备动手时——比大问题更大的大大问题出现了！只要我闭上一只眼睛，另一只眼睛很快就会坚持不住，跟着一起闭上了！

我是不会放弃睡觉的！在不倒貉貉长出手来之前，只有你能帮我了！帮我画…眼睛…

我在老地方等你…站着…等你…

呼噜…

主题：钓鱼好难…

发件人：早柚

时间：2023-10-19

求救！求救！

宫司大人最近忽然想养观赏鱼，为了逃掉修炼，我主动接了钓鱼的任务。

我原本以为，钓鱼就是架好鱼竿，呼呼大睡，等鱼自己上钩。

这一觉确实很香…但睡醒之后，鱼没有，饵也没有！

交不了差的话，休假肯定也要泡汤了…

我到处打听了一下，能在这么短的时间内钓到那种观赏鱼的恐怕只有你了。我寄出了这封加急信件，一定要快快送到。

鱼和午餐我都准备好了，报酬的话…摸摸头应该够了吧？

只要不是摸很久！

我等你过来…呼噜…

主题：长高了…吗？

发件人：早柚

时间：2022-10-19

一个巨大的好消息！最近我只要轻轻一跳，就能抓到晶蝶！以前是要很用力蹦起来才能够着的…所以，我应该是长高了！

但我也不能百分百确定，万一只是晶蝶飞得低了…

能请你过来一趟吗？想让你亲眼看看我有没有长高。比如…摸摸我的头比划一下，但不能摸太久！

你是我的好朋友，一定不会骗我的。要是真的没有长高，也好帮我一起想想其他办法。

这是我俩的秘密，千万不能告诉巫女姐姐…唔…也不能告诉绫华大小姐…还有不能告诉那位宫司大人…还有那位…

呯噜…

主题：睡小觉！

发件人：早柚

时间：2021-10-19

每年今天，巫女姐姐都会送我一块胡萝卜蛋糕祝我生日快乐，还不会抓我去修炼。所以，我把一整天都拿来睡大觉，可舒服了！

呼…但是，今年认识了你，你对我也很重要。我想了想，决定只用半天时间睡小觉！剩下的时间，想和你一起吃一顿…

吃什么呢？啊…鳗肉料理好不好？陆鳗鳗总是伸长脖子向上探头，吃了它一定能长高！我准备了好多好多，希望你能喜欢！

呼…又开始犯困了…我去找棵舒服的大树，边休息边等你。记得叫醒我哦。

呼噜…
